items.title: Nvidia weighs playing the cosigner for Nscale’s AI data center in West Virginia
items.brief: 英伟达或为数据中心贷款担保，帮客户融资以稳住芯片需求
items.summary: When investors get nervous about AI spending, it helps to have the chipmaker that sells the chips offer to cosign the loan.
items.author: Aditya Mehta

items.title: Ollie, a privacy-focused AI assistant, is shutting down
items.brief: 主打隐私的助手停运，小团队难敌大厂免费产品挤压
items.summary: As an increasing number of AI assistants flood the market, the founder of Ollie, an assistant that respected its users' privacy, says it will be shutting down in a week.
items.author: Lucas Ropek

items.title: Anthropic expected to receive high ‘junk’ rating from credit agencies following IPO, FT report says
items.brief: 高垃圾评级将推高融资成本，加剧其巨额支出的资金压力
items.summary: Blackstone's forecast is just a prediction, but naturally, a high junk rating would make it more difficult and costlier for Anthropic to raise the money to keep funding its massive spending that has undergirded its business.
items.author: Lucas Ropek

items.title: Cracks are emerging in the AI spending boom
items.brief: 债务攀升与现金流为负，投资者开始质疑基建投入能否回本
items.summary: Big Tech is pouring billions into AI infrastructure, but mounting debt, negative cash flow, and growing investor skepticism are raising questions about the sustainability of the AI spending boom.
items.author: Rebecca Bellan

items.title: Zest’s new AI agent finds restaurants and books reservations over text
items.brief: AI助手汇总众人口味投票选餐厅，并直接发短信订位
items.summary: Can't agree on where to eat? Zest's AI concierge can combine everyone's tastes, put restaurant options to a vote, and make the reservation.
items.author: Sarah Perez

items.title: Proton's CEO Cancels AI 'Re-Interviews'
items.summary: Article URL: https://www.404media.co/protons-ceo-cancels-ai-re-interviews/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50307183 Points: 263 # Comments: 220
items.author: cdrnsf

items.title: On the Fundamental Limits of Prefill-Based Decoding Length Prediction
items.brief: 仅凭预填充阶段状态预测输出长度，为推理调度提供理论边界
items.summary: Predicting how many tokens a large language model (LLM) will decode, using only prefill-phase hidden states, is a key primitive for inference scheduling.
items.author: Haowen Shi, Xuzhe Yan, Fahao Chen

items.title: Prefix Executability: Evaluating Tool-Using Agents Beyond Final Success
items.summary: Tool-use benchmarks often score agents by final task success, but terminal outcomes can obscure whether the intermediate tool-call trajectory was executable. We propose prefix executability as a trajectory-level evaluation protocol for tool-using agents.
items.author: Amir H. Rezaeian, Weiyi Sun, Yassine Benajiba

items.title: When to Assist and What to Suggest: Joint Gating and Memory-Grounded Hint Generation in One Compact Decoder
items.summary: Proactive assistants offer short, memory-grounded hints during a conversation, deciding when to assist and what to suggest. Current systems split this between a gate and a larger generator; we evaluate both together on 28,058 decision points.
items.author: A. J. A. Jubayer Talukder, Mohammad Ariful Haque

items.title: VeriCUA: Verification as Agentic Exploration for Computer-Using Agents
items.summary: Building and scaling computer-using agents (CUAs) across desktop, mobile, and web environments requires reliable task-completion verification for data curation, evaluation, and reinforcement learning.
items.author: Qiushi Sun, Da Yu, Alexander Knop
